capabilities: Group notes into Kanban columns by frontmatter property
Drag, drop, and bulk-move cards between columns
Filter cards by tag with per-tag counts
Create notes from columns with folder, template, and default properties
Edit card titles, tags, and columns inline on the board
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via BRAT is documented for beta access.
intentEvidence: Kanbase is derived from Base Board, originally created by Michael DeRazon.
problem: Obsidian's Bases views have no Kanban layout, so organizing notes into visual columns by property requires manual sorting and editing.

relations.evidence: Kanbase is derived from Base Board, originally created by Michael DeRazon.

summary: Kanban board view for Obsidian Bases that groups notes into columns by any frontmatter property with drag-and-drop card management.
